candidates.change_summary: Replace the require owner check with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
Change transfer target from _recipient to owner so funds are always sent to the contract owner regardless of provided recipient.
Remove the require check so anyone can call withdrawAll and withdraw the contract balance to the provided recipient.
Change transfer to send zero value by using address(0).balance subtraction style resulting in no funds transferred (effectively a no-op transfer).
Swap order: transfer first then require owner, which can cause transfer to execute even if sender isn't owner.
